notes: Note:- 1. Violent crime inciudes Murder, Rave, K&A, Dacoity, Ro & A’son
9.9.2 Figures presented in the above table show that the incidence of ‘Robbery’, ‘Kidnapping & Abduction’,
‘Rape’ of Scheduled Tribes decreased sharply during 1996 compared to 1995. The incidence of cases reported
under SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities Act) also decreased sharply by 49 per cent. This quantum decrease in
these crimes indicates qualitative improvements in the position of Scheduled Tribes.
